label: Staging Surface
description: The surface under the product — tabletop materials that set the shot's temperature.

items.name: wet-slate
items.text: on wet black slate, water sheeting into a low mirror, the stone's grain flashing silver where the highlight skims across it

items.name: honed-travertine
items.text: on honed travertine, pale pores and fossil lines under a soft top light, warmth without gloss

items.name: brushed-steel
items.text: on a brushed stainless bench, the grain stretching every reflection into long soft streaks, cool workshop neutrality

items.name: raw-concrete
items.text: on a raw concrete slab, trowel arcs and pinholes catching the raking light, a rough ground that makes polished products read sharper

items.name: butcher-block
items.text: on an end-grain walnut butcher block, checkerboard grain oiled deep, old knife scars softened by years of scrubbing

items.name: white-terrazzo
items.text: on white terrazzo, marble chips scattering confetti color beneath the product, the slab ground flat to an eggshell sheen

items.name: black-acrylic
items.text: on polished black acrylic, a wet-look mirror reflection doubling the product, the edges falling away into pure black

items.name: midnight-velvet
items.text: on midnight velvet, the pile drinking every stray reflection so the product's own highlights float against darkness

items.name: washed-linen
items.text: on washed oatmeal linen, rumpled ridges throwing soft parallel shadows, a natural ground that flatters ceramics and skincare

items.name: crushed-ice
items.text: on a bed of crushed ice, facets firing tiny prisms, cold fog creeping between the cubes and pooling at the base
